title: Publish guides, glossary and an inclusive onboarding hub
interface: Versioned resources/glossary and onboarding_progress use owner/review dates, visibility, checklist version and stable term aliases.
steps: Build Start Here checklist, contextual acronym explanations, service/process guides, who's-who links and practice sandbox task/request.
Provide head/publisher authoring with drafts, safe content, review reminders, ownership and published version. Treat MEA expansion as unconfirmed until supplied.
Allow skipped optional tours, late joiners and incomplete-task empty states; all core backgrounds receive equal guidance.
checks: A member with no affiliation/course disclosure can complete essential onboarding.
Renamed glossary label retains old alias and links without breaking forms.
Restricted resource/file does not become public through guide links or preview; sandbox never submits a real FIN case.

title: Manage roster, deployments, unit rename/merge/archive
interface: Organization commands preview impact, preserve UUID/history, reassign active work explicitly and create aliases; deployments are scoped dated grants.
steps: Build add/edit/archive unit and roster/deployment screens with active owners and service contacts. Avoid hardcoding the illustrative eight committees.
Implement rename/merge impact preview including open work, active reviewers and access deltas; old records preserve original unit identity.
Require replacement for orphaned active ownership/approval; merge does not silently union all privileges or move restricted case contents.
checks: Renaming MCD/unit keeps original tracking IDs and deep links.
Merge cannot unexpectedly grant another committee access to FIN/PRISM or historical private tasks.
Archiving a head/unit with active cases either assigns an authorized replacement or leaves explicit blocked work.

title: Build safe role editing and access explanations
interface: Role administration chooses fixed resource/action/scope capabilities, dated assignments and delegation ceilings; preview explains effective access without real impersonation.
steps: Build roles/permission grid, unit/record scope assignment, expiry, revoke and audit history for authorized grantors.
Protect last super admin, sensitive-review capabilities, emergency access boundary and no self-escalation; distinguish app roles from provider-console ownership.
Provide synthetic role preview and access-explanation results with current grants/mandatory constraints; no administrative read-all endpoint.
checks: Delegated head cannot grant FIN/PRISM/admin beyond grantor ceiling or edit own privileges upward.
Last technical custodian cannot be removed without a verified replacement path.
Membership/role expiry is honored immediately; synthetic preview cannot expose another user's real sensitive record.

title: Implement shared configuration draft, validation and publication
interface: publish_configuration(expectedVersion, idempotencyKey) creates immutable version; rollback creates a new version and revalidates privilege/invariants.
steps: Establish supported configuration kinds and draft storage, version history, diff, validation, synthetic preview and explicit publish.
Validate same-term references, capability ceilings, reserved semantics and required gates before activation; preserve pinned historical requests.
Add conflict handling for simultaneous editors and canonical audit/outbox publication. No arbitrary JSON console bypass for business users.
checks: Invalid/missing references or removed mandatory FIN/MCD gate cannot publish.
Two administrators cannot overwrite each other's published version silently.
Rollback preserves intervening history and never rewrites open cases' pinned workflow/schema.

title: Build the no-code request form editor
interface: Editor produces the same FormDefinition accepted by P20, preserving stable keys/options and routing confidential payloads correctly.
steps: Implement field/section add/edit/reorder/remove-draft, supported types, help, required conditions, options and repeatable lines with keyboard controls.
Add synthetic preview and schema validation; enforce limits and fixed operators. Reserved finance/approval values remain typed protected fields.
Publish through P35; show impact on drafts and explicit migration rather than changing submitted data. Explain why confidential fields need restricted storage/type.
checks: Renaming a label does not change stored field key/old answer meaning.
A confidential custom field cannot publish into broad ordinary JSON.
Published old form submissions remain readable under their version; unsafe condition/code and excessive schema size fail.

title: Build the bounded workflow and approval editor
interface: Workflow editor emits P22-compatible sequential stable stages, one/all eligible reviewers, revision routes and bounded conditions; publication uses P35.
steps: Implement stage ordering, reviewer/role/scope resolution, required evidence, decision routes, authorized delegates and reminder settings.
Preview synthetic cases including requester conflict and missing authority; show open cases pinned to previous versions.
Reject unbounded loops, unsafe scripts, nonexistent approvers and configurations bypassing FIN/MCD protected policy. No generic BPM product.
checks: Head can configure a service review without editing source code.
Removing a required financial/creative authority or assigning only requester as reviewer fails publication.
New version applies to new instances; an active old case continues or explicitly migrates with audited authority.

title: Edit phases, semantic statuses and service routing
interface: Admin controls edit display labels/order, phase dates and service contacts while stable IDs/semantic categories remain authoritative.
steps: Add phase management and current-phase display; validate active phase selection and date order without assuming prototype phase names.
Add status-label/color/order editor with protected semantics and accessible contrast; cannot turn a pending state into an approved decision.
Add service name/description, receiving unit, primary/backup contacts, official form link, lead-time text and guest eligibility with impact validation.
checks: Renamed PRISM/status/phase does not change authority, routes or historical meaning.
Invalid phase date range or inactive required contact is reported before publish.
A status called Approved without a valid decision still fails readiness; published copy updates through versioned config.

title: Implement general site Edit Mode, labels and branding
interface: Site pages use safe block catalog and label/theme config via P35; approved-logo asset separate from interface font/accent.
steps: Implement authenticated contextual Edit Mode for supported text/link/card blocks, navigation wording/order, guide copy and branding tokens.
Add draft/preview/diff/publish/revert and role-aware synthetic previews. Keep licensed logo shape/name/color protected by approved-asset selection and MCD review record.
Check contrast and focus visibility; keep Karla/calm tokens by default. No arbitrary HTML/CSS/JavaScript injection or fresh decorative redesign.
checks: Typing in Edit Mode is private until publish and rollback records a new version.
Renaming labels does not break deep links, workflow semantics or permission keys.
Unsafe block content or inaccessible token combination is rejected/warned with a concrete repair; ordinary members cannot enter editor.

title: Configure widgets and layouts by role
interface: Role/unit layout config selects fixed widget IDs and supported options; each widget independently queries authorized data.
steps: Implement role layouts, responsive placement/order/size, saved operational views and preview. Provide keyboard Move Up/Down, not drag-only controls.
Offer existing task/waiting/deliverables/synergy/review/calendar/resource widgets only; optional-module widgets appear only when enabled.
Retain a required route/action path so layout cannot hide all next actions; prevent arbitrary SQL/query definition.
checks: A member cannot obtain FIN data by adding a FIN widget to a layout.
Same layout remains usable on 320px screen and with keyboard reordering.
Missing/retired widget produces a clear safe fallback and configuration validation, not a broken dashboard.

title: Configure notification rules, schedules and preferences
interface: Rules select fixed events/audiences/channels with dedup, bounded schedule and Manila quiet hours; delivery preference does not remove required work.
steps: Add admin rules, recipient dry-run, safe templates, due/overdue reminders, digest/mute choices and channel availability.
Implement default two-days-before/due-day/daily-overdue scheduling and 20:00–08:00 quiet period as editable proposals, using tested Manila dates.
Use durable deduplication and outbox dispatch; external channels remain disabled until configured/verified in optional steps.
checks: Scheduler retry/window overlap creates no duplicate digest or reminder.
Muted external delivery does not hide the in-app pending obligation.
Recipient preview respects access; private payload cannot be inserted into external-message templates.

title: Publish scoped announcements and acknowledgments
interface: Published announcement has audience, immutable revisions, pin/expiry, publisher and acknowledgments against material revision.
steps: Build draft/publish/edit/pin/expire and core/committee audience selection for authorized publishers.
Add acknowledgment and material-edit renewed acknowledgment without treating it as a legal waiver.
Wire overview/inbox and private file visibility. Guests need explicit share; resource-draft ability is not announcement publisher authority.
checks: Other committee/guest cannot enumerate unshared announcement contents or counts.
Materially edited announcement does not reuse prior acknowledgment silently.
Narrower attachment remains restricted even when announcement audience is wider.

title: Implement permission-filtered keyword search
interface: search_workspace(query, filters, cursor) applies authorization before snippets/counts across operational titles/IDs, guides and allowed contacts.
steps: Add suitable PostgreSQL full-text/trigram indexes and exact term-aware tracking lookup; support renamed-unit aliases.
Build categorized accessible results, empty/error states and safe restricted-result behavior.
Exclude finance raw payload, evaluations, private profile fields and attachment extraction from global index. No external AI search.
checks: Searching a known private title/amount/contact or restricted ID reveals no existence/count/snippet.
Exact ID distinguishes terms and maps renamed unit aliases without collisions.
Typeahead/keyboard/mobile behavior works; SQL parameters and pagination cannot widen scope.

title: Build workload, readiness and meaningful-usage reports
interface: Scoped SQL reports use documented event allowlist and Monday–Sunday Manila periods; minimal first-party events, no sensitive bodies.
steps: Implement readiness, overdue/original dates, blocked duration, queue age, handoff/approval turnaround and assigned workload with clear definitions.
Add meaningful weekly active numerator/eligible-core denominator, excluding guests/tests/bots; instrument safe work views/actions and retention for usage events.
Restrict supervisory breakdowns and exports; no public member ranking, affiliation comparison or fake utilization percentages.
checks: At 89 eligible members, at least 72 meaningful active members meets 80%; logins/bot pings alone do not.
Multi-unit users are counted once and Manila week boundary is correct.
Changing deadline does not erase original overdue history; small/private groups do not reveal protected records.

title: Add previewed Sheets-compatible CSV import and scoped export
interface: Import preview/mapping/validation commits through authorized existing commands with stable IDs; export uses effective scope and spreadsheet-safe values.
steps: Support roster/tasks import templates, row-level error report, deduplication, dry-run and confirmation of exact mapped changes.
Do not turn role columns or imported identity fields into unreviewed privileges; sensitive financial imports use separate authorized template/reconciliation.
Export permitted operations with stable IDs and neutralize spreadsheet formula prefixes; preserve dates/UTF-8/newlines correctly. No bidirectional Sheets sync.
checks: Repeated import does not duplicate records and partial errors are reported consistently with chosen atomicity.
CSV containing =,+,-,@ formula payloads cannot execute when opened in a spreadsheet as exported user content.
Unauthorized export/import changes fail; role field cannot grant admin and unrelated private rows never appear.

title: Implement privacy notice, restricted access logs and retention controls
interface: Versioned privacy notice, category retention_rules, legal_holds, auditable access/export and timed emergency grants; routine private reads use audited restricted endpoints.
steps: Build notice/optional sharing acknowledgments, custodian request intake, authorized access/correction/export handling, retention policy configuration and hold review.
Implement dry-run disposition/purge planning without running live deletion; distinguish archive from erasure, preserve necessary minimal ledger and restore replay.
Add time-bounded emergency access with reason/notification and no routine broad admin contents. Block sensitive-module activation without owner/basis/retention decisions.
checks: Legal hold prevents scheduled disposal and dry-run lists affected records/files without exposing their contents.
Admin cannot silently self-grant indefinite raw FIN/PRISM access through UI.
All normal restricted reads/exports are logged through authorized endpoints; raw sensitive payloads/tokens do not enter telemetry.

title: Implement encrypted backup and prove identity/file recovery
interface: Backup manifest covers app data/config, schema, file bytes/hashes, identity linkage recovery, retention/purge replay and separate key custody; freshness visible to custodians.
steps: Implement documented encrypted export and verify tools' actual Auth/Storage inclusion/exclusion. Keep backups/secrets out of Git artifacts and ordinary member folders.
Add restoration into an explicitly verified isolated local/authorized recovery target; preserve stable member IDs or test verified provider re-linking.
Rehearse login, permissions, immutable decisions/files and purge replay; record actual RPO/RTO, missing prerequisites and second-custodian runbook. Do not invent a successful rehearsal.
checks: Restored user can log in to correct scope; unauthorized user cannot read recovered private files.
Manifest counts/file hashes match and expired/purged data does not silently resurrect.
Stale/failed backup appears in health; missing device/provider/key makes verification blocked, not green.
